#include <string>

    std::string data;

    int evenSequences = 0;
    int index = 0;
    while (index < data.length()) {
        int sequenceLength = 1;
        while (index + 1 < data.length() && data[index] == data[index + 1]) {
            sequenceLength++;
            index++;

        if (sequenceLength % 2 == 0) {
            evenSequences++;
        }

    }
    std::cout << evenSequences << std::endl;
    return 0;
}
